_readme: S644, 2026-11-13. Read 2 (run 43341770461, 3 loads): the grid at www.dvc.edu/academics/explore-our-programs pages by ?page=0..5 and links each program area at explore-our-programs/<slug> (administration-justice, business). A program area page names each award (Associate in Science - Administration of Justice; Associate in Science for Transfer - Administration of Justice; Certificate of Achievement - Police/Law Enforcement; ten in all) and prints no course or unit. This read loads the Administration of Justice page with the award links shown, and follows three awards (the transfer degree, the local degree, a certificate) where they stay on dvc.edu, to see where each award's required courses and units are printed. No model call.
